title: Reconstruction, emulator and fidelity maintenance
summary: Review eleven material upstream changes across reconstruction fidelity, decompilation, emulator determinism, release safety and tooling.
notes: The CPU audit queue contained zero unresolved source/target CPU areas, so this pass resolved zero CPU audit areas rather than inventing architecture work. Primary commits were reviewed; no upstream project was compiled or executed, and no runtime minimum was inferred from platform, language or broad architecture.

Reviewed Ambermoon.net battle-fidelity commits and checked the profile-adjacent scope; no newly titled project was established.
Reviewed replay-seek sequencing and parallel-test hardening across the existing multi-model emulator project.

Reviewed the 0.20 GCC-packaged release and ECN tools-test change; minimum Amiga requirements remain undocumented.

project.status: Sharp MZ emulator/debugger now returns replay-seek run identifiers for reliable stop waits and hardens parallel testing so all built MZ-800/700/1500 binaries are exercised without oversubscribing shared MSYS Git/Bash resources.

identity.narrative: Open-source Sharp MZ emulator with cycle-accurate Z80A execution, chip/peripheral emulation, a built-in debugger and an MCP bridge exposing screenshots, coverage, profiling and analysis controls. Primary docs provide Linux, Windows and macOS build paths; no minimum host CPU or RAM is stated. Claude client configuration documents a supported integration, not evidence that AI authored the project. Current main saves hidden Z80 MEMPTR, interrupt, EI-delay and T-state state plus CTC, scroll, VRAM-wait and floppy-controller state; it safely adapts RAMdisk/IDE8 snapshot loads. Debugger/MCP fixes expose all 532 expanded memory regions, keep debugger reads from firing guest watchpoints, correctly stop temporary run-to breakpoints and record the instruction bytes actually fetched by self-modifying code. Evidence: https://github.com/michalhucik/mz800emu/commit/1f477d90e2efd6808253c1c3d5f31fa56f465570 https://github.com/michalhucik/mz800emu/commit/a5726b9658d10b4412cf4a28bc212a78351f28a4 Current main adds frame-boundary-synchronized memory search across user RAM, logical Z80 space, VRAM, extension banks, RAM disks and other writable memory, with numeric/string types, filters, undo/redo, candidate actions, freeze controls and write-origin inspection. Matching MCP tools expose searches and freezes for automation, and the same change fixes the missing second half of PEHU 512 KiB memory. A maintained locale catalog at the reviewed commit explicitly names Claude Code as Last-Translator, correcting the prior no-evidence AI audit while keeping attribution limited to that content. Evidence: https://github.com/michalhucik/mz800emu/commit/0e4967ca56d162bcd2dc3607ebab986f9e029e78 https://github.com/michalhucik/mz800emu/blob/0e4967ca56d162bcd2dc3607ebab986f9e029e78/src/locale/de/LC_MESSAGES/mz800emu.po

classification.narrative: The changes extend the existing Sharp MZ system emulator/debugger with deterministic state inspection and safer emulation-thread scheduling.
